The scheduler split is set to diagnostic only to permit a reversible pre-resource gate check while the coarse supervisor backup_status is failed; the script's own pre-resource backup/prior gate remains mandatory and must fail with zero solver/plant usage if no verified post-v0h backup proof exists. If a valid verified backup proof is present before resources, the same bounded microcontinuation may proceed under the stated caps and must report full cost/safety/solver/timing traces. This is still IMPROVED development-only operational repair evidence, not ORIGINAL reproduction or independent validation.
